cards.html: This skill answers "what is Firebase, and what does it cost?" so you can pick one product without buying the whole catalogue.
Google bundles a dozen services under one console. They are separable: you can use Cloud Messaging and nothing else. Most of the confusion about "using Firebase" comes from forgetting this.

ProductWhat it doesReach for it whenLock-in
Cloud Messaging (FCM)Push from your server to an app installYou must wake a closed appLow
AuthenticationManaged sign-in (social, phone, email)You have no accounts systemHigh
Firestore / Realtime DatabaseManaged database with live listenersYou want a backend with no serverHigh
Cloud FunctionsServerless codeYou want endpoints without running a serverMedium
HostingStatic site and CDN hostingYou have a web front endLow
Crashlytics / AnalyticsCrash reports and usage dataYou have a published appMedium
Remote Config / App CheckFeature flags and abuse protectionYou change behaviour without a releaseMedium

The lock-in column is a judgment [depends], not a measurement.

• FCM itself is free, with no per-message charge, and works on the no-cost Spark plan [consensus, fast-moving: check Firebase's pricing page].
  • Other products, such as databases, functions, storage and SMS-based phone sign-in, are where bills appear. Some need the pay-as-you-go Blaze plan, which requires a card.
  • If your server sends the pushes and you use none of those products, you pay nothing.
  • Publishing on the Play Store has its own one-time fee, but sideloading an APK does not need it, and FCM does not require it.

• Push is a leaf. Swapping FCM later means changing the sender and the client registration. Nothing else depends on it.
  • Database and login are roots. Firestore and Firebase Authentication are your data and identity layer. Migrating them is a real project [consensus].
  • The rule of thumb: adopt the leaf, and think hard before adopting the roots.

o: a catalogue of separable app services
quiz.why: You can adopt one product and ignore the rest.

quiz.q: Which Firebase products carry high lock-in?
quiz.why: They become your data and identity layer.

quiz.q: Sending push through FCM requires the paid Blaze plan.
quiz.why: Myth. FCM is free and works on the no-cost Spark plan (verify current pricing).

quiz.q: The rule of thumb 'adopt the leaf, doubt the roots' means …
o: use push, but think hard before using Firebase's database and login
quiz.why: Push is easy to swap out; data and login are not.
